Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Our proposal includes a price adjustment clause on the cost driver you named.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We agree to the implementation of a price adjustment clause for copper, which allows us to remove the material risk premium from our base price. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days. We offer a price of €361.82 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

# Framework agreement 4600070510

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Motor IE3 4 kW, 4-pole, Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 35 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

Parts: part:350010, part:350011

# Holiday shutdown

email - 2025-10-19 - Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

Annual review with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Their key account manager explained that price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

letter - 2026-09-14 - Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Dear Sir or Madam,

we have supplied Hollerau Pumpenwerke reliably for many years. Owing to the strong rise in copper and electronic component prices, we are forced to adjust our prices for Motor IE3 7.5 kW, 4-pole (part:350011) by **6.5 %** with effect from **01 January 2027**: from EUR 348.32 to EUR 370.96 per  pc.

We regret this step and ask for your understanding.

Yours faithfully,
Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
